app.description: SingLilt - score playback and singing practice
app.backend_error: audio-backend must be sampled or system
cli.recognize: Recognize an image locally and exit.
cli.vision_endpoint: Use a vision API base URL or full Chat Completions endpoint instead of local OCR.
cli.vision_model: Model for an explicitly requested vision endpoint.
cli.inspect: Validate a saved project and exit.
cli.timeline: Include expanded verse/program/lyric events in JSON reports.
cli.smoke_verse: Start GUI smoke at the first lyric in a zero-based verse.
cli.smoke: Exercise GUI, playback and project roundtrip then exit.
cli.audio_backend: GUI audio backend override: sampled or system (not saved).
cli.render_wave: Render sampled piano to a WAV without an audio device.
cli.render_seconds: Maximum musical seconds before a 1.5 second release tail.
cli.velocity: Override base note velocity for WAV rendering (1..127).
cli.uniform: Disable deterministic beat accents for WAV rendering.
cli.language: Language override: zh_CN or en_US (not saved).
cli.ui_check: Check translations, state preservation and dropdown contrast.
cli.catalog_check: Validate embedded language resources and exit.
cli.vision_timeout: Vision request timeout in seconds (30-1800, default 600).
cli.async_check: Run the focused background recognition UI check with a loopback fixture service.
cli.project_check: Check portable project persistence and File menu.
cli.project_test_audio: MP3 fixture for portable project diagnostics.
cli.product_workspace_check: Check score workspace and edit state.
